title: Fix a Pod Volume Claim
prompt:
In namespace `cka-st-claim`, Pod `web` mounts claim `pvc-wrong`, which does not exist, so the Pod stays `Pending`. The correct claim `pvc-data` is already `Bound`.

Perform the following tasks:
1. Fix Pod `web` so it mounts PersistentVolumeClaim `pvc-data`.
2. Keep the Pod image `nginx:1.27-alpine`.
3. The Pod must become `Running` and `Ready`.

docs_links.label: Configure a Pod to Use a PVC

manifests:
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolume
metadata:
  name: pv-data
spec:
  capacity:
    storage: 1Gi
  accessModes:
  - ReadWriteOnce
  storageClassName: manual
  hostPath:
    path: /tmp/cka-st-claim-data
    type: DirectoryOrCreate
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: pvc-data
  namespace: cka-st-claim
spec:
  accessModes:
  - ReadWriteOnce
  storageClassName: manual
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 1Gi
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: web
  namespace: cka-st-claim
  labels:
    app: web
spec:
  containers:
  - name: web
    image: nginx:1.27-alpine
    volumeMounts:
    - name: data
      mountPath: /usr/share/nginx/html
  volumes:
  - name: data
    persistentVolumeClaim:
      claimName: pvc-wrong

checks.failure_hint: The Pod references a missing claim — point it at pvc-data.
Recreate the Pod with claimName pvc-data.
The claim is provided by the scenario; keep it.
Do not change the Pod image.

manifests:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: web
  namespace: cka-st-claim
  labels:
    app: web
spec:
  containers:
  - name: web
    image: nginx:1.27-alpine
    volumeMounts:
    - name: data
      mountPath: /usr/share/nginx/html
  volumes:
  - name: data
    persistentVolumeClaim:
      claimName: pvc-data

reference_solution:
Recreate the Pod with the correct claim.
```bash
kubectl -n cka-st-claim delete pod web --ignore-not-found
kubectl -n cka-st-claim apply -f web-pod.yaml
```
hints: Inspect `k -n cka-st-claim describe pod web` and list available PVCs with `k -n cka-st-claim get pvc`.
Pod `spec.volumes` is immutable; capture YAML with `-o yaml > pod.yaml`, update the claimName, then delete and recreate the Pod.
fast_solution_commands: k -n cka-st-claim get pod web -o yaml > web.yaml
